subject: Use when designing tests that verify the interaction between two or more units of a system — modules, services,…

evals.prompt: Define integration-test-design in 2-3 sentences. Include the work it owns and the kind of user request that should activate it.
Explain why an agent would need the integration-test-design skill instead of relying on generic reasoning. Name the failure it prevents.
Describe the mental model or main primitives behind integration-test-design. Keep it operational rather than just naming the topic.
A user asks: "test a single function in isolation (use testing-strategy + test-doubles-design)". Should integration-test-design activate? Explain the boundary and name the better owner when possible.
evals.negative_expectation: Must not force integration-test-design onto a request it explicitly excludes or that belongs to test-driven-development, testing-strategy, test-doubles-design, e2e-test-design, contract-testing.

evals.prompt: A user asks: "design an integration test for the order service that exercises real database and real message bus". Show the first concrete steps an agent should take when applying integration-test-design.

Place integration-test-design among its adjacent skills (test-driven-development, testing-strategy, test-doubles-design, e2e-test-design, contract-testing). What does it own, and what does it verify with or defer to?
evals.negative_expectation: Must not collapse related skills into interchangeable names; ownership must be mechanism-level.

evals.prompt: Name one plausible misconception about integration-test-design and correct it with a mechanism-level explanation.
